title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #17 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. To whom was Mary engaged to be married? (1 mark)
   A. David
   B. Joseph
   C. Simeon
   D. Zechariah

2. Which quality of Mary should we copy? (1 mark)
   A. Trust in God and humility
   B. Pride
   C. Greed
   D. Anger

3. Where was Zechariah when the angel appeared to him? (1 mark)
   A. At home
   B. In the temple
   C. By the river
   D. On a mountain

4. Which of these helps to protect our eyes? (1 mark)
   A. Not rubbing them with dirty hands
   B. Reading in the dark
   C. Staring at the sun
   D. Throwing dust

5. Where was Bartimaeus sitting when Jesus passed? (1 mark)
   A. On a boat
   B. In the temple
   C. At a market
   D. By the roadside near Jericho

6. How should people with contagious diseases be treated? (1 mark)
   A. By making fun of them
   B. With rejection
   C. With insults
   D. With care and respect

7. What does gratitude mean? (1 mark)
   A. Complaining
   B. Boasting
   C. Showing thanks
   D. Being angry

8. What is a widow? (1 mark)
   A. A queen
   B. A woman without children
   C. A teacher
   D. A woman whose husband has died

9. What does compassion mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being angry
   B. Ignoring others
   C. Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   D. Laughing at others

10. Who is a needy person? (1 mark)
   A. Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   B. Only adults
   C. Only foreigners
   D. Someone who is wealthy

11. Which verse tells us to give to the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Matthew 5:42
   D. Acts 2:38

12. What does the lost coin stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A rich man
   B. A house
   C. A lamp
   D. A person who has wandered from God

13. Which value do we learn when we plant and water a seed? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Responsibility and patience
   C. Greed
   D. Jealousy

14. What is the mustard seed like in size? (1 mark)
   A. Medium
   B. Very large
   C. Very small
   D. As big as an egg

15. What did Nicodemus bring to prepare Jesus' body for burial? (1 mark)
   A. Gold
   B. Myrrh and aloes
   C. Bread
   D. Oil only

16. What did Jesus say a person must be to see the kingdom of God? (1 mark)
   A. Born again
   B. Old
   C. Rich
   D. A priest

17. Why should we trust God always? (1 mark)
   A. He is loving and faithful
   B. He is unknown
   C. He forgets
   D. He is far

18. A stranger offers you a lift. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Accept
   B. Give your name
   C. Go with them
   D. Say no and tell a trusted adult

19. What does exaggeration mean? (1 mark)
   A. Making things sound bigger than they are
   B. Being kind
   C. Being silent
   D. Telling the exact truth

20. Which commandment forbids false testimony? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:3
   B. Exodus 20:15
   C. Exodus 20:16
   D. Exodus 20:12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State two things the angel Gabriel said about the child that Mary would bear. (2 marks)

22. Describe how the story of the shepherd boy and the wolf shows the results of lying. (4 marks)

23. Name two needs that people may have. (2 marks)

24. Explain how John the Baptist prepared the way for Jesus and what we can learn about living righteously. (5 marks)

25. Who were the parents of John the Baptist? (2 marks)

26. In your own words, what is a parable and why did Jesus use them? (2 marks)

27. Give four benefits of forgiving others. (4 marks)

28. Name two ways of showing compassion to a grieving neighbour. (2 marks)

29. State two reasons why we should tell the truth. (2 marks)

30. Explain how Jesus and Joseph are examples of forgiveness. (3 marks)

31. Give two forms of dishonesty other than lying. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Joseph
   Mary was engaged to Joseph of the house of David.

2. A — Trust in God and humility
   Mary trusted God and called herself the Lord's servant.

3. B — In the temple
   He was burning incense in the temple.

4. A — Not rubbing them with dirty hands
   Clean hands protect the eyes from infection.

5. D — By the roadside near Jericho
   Mark 10:46 says he was by the roadside.

6. D — With care and respect
   Jesus showed kindness to those with leprosy.

7. C — Showing thanks
   Gratitude is being thankful.

8. D — A woman whose husband has died
   A widow has lost her husband.

9. C — Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   Compassion moves us to help.

10. A — Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   Needy people lack basic things.

11. C — Matthew 5:42
   Matthew 5:42 says to give to the one who asks.

12. D — A person who has wandered from God
   The coin stands for a lost person.

13. B — Responsibility and patience
   Caring for a plant teaches responsibility.

14. C — Very small
   It is one of the smallest seeds.

15. B — Myrrh and aloes
   John 19:39 says he brought myrrh and aloes.

16. A — Born again
   John 3:3 records this.

17. A — He is loving and faithful
   God is reliable.

18. D — Say no and tell a trusted adult
   Never go with strangers.

19. A — Making things sound bigger than they are
   Exaggerating is not being truthful.

20. C — Exodus 20:16
   Exodus 20:16 forbids false testimony.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: He will be great, He will be called Son of the Most High, He will have the throne of David, His kingdom will never end. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid statement.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy lied twice that a wolf was coming. Villagers came and found nothing. When a real wolf came, nobody believed him. Lies destroy trust.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing, shelter, medicine, school items, friendship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid need.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: John preached in the wilderness, called people to repent and baptised them, so their hearts were ready for Jesus. We can learn to turn away from sin, be honest and kind, pray, and tell others about Jesus by our example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for preaching, 1 for repentance, 1 for baptism or readiness, 1 for turning from sin, 1 for a righteous example.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Zechariah and Elizabeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: A short story used to teach a lesson about God and life. Stories are easy to remember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for story and 1 for teaching a lesson.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Peace, restored friendship, freedom from anger, pleasing God, fewer fights.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit up to 4.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Visit, comfort, share food, pray with them. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: God commands it; people trust us; we feel peaceful; friendships stay strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed for those who crucified Him. Joseph forgave his brothers and cared for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Joseph, 1 for what each did.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Cheating, blaming others, exaggerating, gossiping, breaking promises.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
